prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / mecha design refinement. Make one new full-body three-quarter mechanical concept drawing of the orange-and-white combined giant robot in image 1. Plain warm ivory background, no text, no labels, no auras, no circular effects.

Reference roles: image 1 controls the established design identity, orange/ivory coloring, crown, orange-white mechanical mane, complete humanoid core and four-component assembly. Image 2 (v17) controls the intimidating upper-body bomber-over-torso silhouette and REAL physical fist/forearm weight, NOT its photoreal textures or short stature. Image 3 (v19) controls the taller heroic overall height/head-body proportion only; do not copy its shoulder trains. Image 4 controls how split train shells go outside the existing heavy forearms, with nose/cab ends toward the rear/elbows and halves opened sideways left/right; they are not whole trains pointing forward. Image 5 controls the chest organization and drill/tread leg construction.

The current image 1 is too polite and its hands read weak. Redesign the ACTUAL fists and reinforced forearms to look overwhelmingly powerful, not just their surrounding train sleeves. Each closed fist is a very broad massive solid block, approximately 1.4 times the visible head width, with four huge square armored knuckles, thick finger plates, a clear opposing thumb and a deep palm mass. Increase the actual knuckles/finger/palm volume around 40 percent relative to image 1. The broad hand front remains fully visible and projects clearly beyond the outer forearm ring. Wrist is a short load-bearing thick joint, not a thin pin. Forearms have thick orange segmented cylindrical reinforcement, stout mechanical bracing and a strong shoulder-to-elbow-to-fist load path. The train half-shells are side-mounted OUTSIDE that heavy reinforcement; they are secondary and leave the fist unobscured. No duplicated hands, no open palm, no weapon replacing the hand, no glove connected to a knee.

Restore v17's bomber mass: an actual broad swept-wing bomber covers the upper torso and shoulders as a continuous airframe, with one orange cockpit nose over the chest. Wide powerful wing roots and big upper fuselage, no duplicated cockpit stacked underneath it. Bomber wings are aircraft wings with clear panels, not passenger train cabins with rows of windows. Keep the current tall humanoid core, long mane and distinctive symmetrical crown. Maintain v19's tall head/body ratio and long legs, not a squat toy. Keep v18's broad feet, external track assemblies along the shins and two forward-facing knee drills.

Pose and framing: powerful braced ready stance, torso leaning slightly into the viewer, broad chest and open shoulder spacing, both massive fists lifted a little forward of the hips with one subtly closer to camera. Mildly low camera, not extreme foreshortening, whole crown/wingtips/feet inside frame. The fists should be the principal foreground masses but all mechanical connections must be readable. Retain leg length and tall stature; do not solve weight by shortening the entire robot.

Rendering: confident hand-drawn KINETIC_CEL super-robot animation key art, clean designed ink, crisp flat orange/ivory/graphite planes and one hard shadow band. Minimal scratches, restrained mechanical detail, no photoreal PBR or chrome gradients. One robot, one coherent drawing, no effects hiding the hands.
